topic.title: Optimizer Design, Learned Updates, and Stability
topic.overview: Optimizers determine both how quickly a network learns and which solution it reaches. This cluster studies learned update rules, lookahead, variance reduction, curvature methods, warmup, and gradient-free dynamics. The representatives examine optimization as a dynamical process whose stability and implicit bias can matter as much as short-term loss reduction.
topic.whyItMatters: A faster training-loss decrease need not improve generalization, and learned optimizers can fail because their own training gradients are biased or unstable. Wall-clock cost, validation behavior, and stability boundaries provide complementary measures of progress.
topic.evolution: Early examples develop stochastic descent and weight-specific training schemes. Later work tackles meta-training pathologies and scalable learned optimizers. Recent analyses examine large-model variance reduction, optimizer-specific implicit bias, and zeroth-order stability governed by broader Hessian-spectrum information than in ordinary first-order updates.
openQuestions: Which learned update rules transfer beyond the tasks used to train the optimizer?
Can practical diagnostics anticipate instability without computing a full curvature spectrum?

papers.title: MADA: Meta-Adaptive Optimizers Through Hyper-Gradient Descent

papers.title: A Layer-Wise Natural Gradient Optimizer for Training Deep Neural Networks

papers.title: Adam with model exponential moving average is effective for nonconvex optimization

papers.title: ADOPT: Modified Adam Can Converge with Any $\beta_2$ with the Optimal Rate

papers.title: An Improved Empirical Fisher Approximation for Natural Gradient Descent

papers.title: Exact, Tractable Gauss-Newton Optimization in Deep Reversible Architectures Reveal Poor Generalization

papers.title: Improving Deep Learning Optimization through Constrained Parameter Regularization

papers.title: Memory-Efficient Gradient Unrolling for Large-Scale Bi-level Optimization

papers.title: MomentumSMoE: Integrating Momentum into Sparse Mixture of Experts

papers.title: Multi-Stage Predict+Optimize for (Mixed Integer) Linear Programs

papers.title: Newton Losses: Using Curvature Information for Learning with Differentiable Algorithms

papers.title: OptEx: Expediting First-Order Optimization with Approximately Parallelized Iterations

papers.title: PACE: Marrying generalization in PArameter-efficient fine-tuning with Consistency rEgularization

papers.title: ST$_k$: A Scalable Module for Solving Top-k Problems

papers.title: Unified Gradient-Based Machine Unlearning with Remain Geometry Enhancement
